rationale: RECEIVER TYPING PAYLOAD (Lead/owner contract 2026-10-18): Java is statically typed, so a call's receiver has a DECLARED type written in the file (field / formal parameter / local variable / a method's return type). The calls edge publishes the bare leaf (`paint`, `clear`) and loses that owner, which is why 828 of 855 unresolved calls at cap 50 are bare member leaves. This fixture pins the ADDITIVE half the lane owns: metadata.owner = the declared type name as written, metadata.ownerEvidence in {field,param,local,return} = WHICH declaration stated it. It also pins the SAME payload on a READS edge (the store channel resolves member rows for uses too): `paramWidget.width` emits `readCase -> width` with owner Widget/param, because a read's target is the member leaf and nothing else names its owner. It pins NO target change (JD20's bare-leaf contract and the differential oracle must be untouched), which is why every expectation here is a `calls` row whose target is still the leaf. Authored from Java semantics before observing the fix. Four positive cases, one per evidence class, each a different declaration form: a field (also via `this.field`), a formal parameter (also a single-type-IMPORTED parameter, which is how most receivers are written: `List` not `java.util.List`), a local variable (declared in the same block), and a method return type (`w.self().paint()`). Three negatives, because the metadata must not guess: a CLASS-QUALIFIED static call (`Helper.help()` — the receiver already names its owner, so owner would be a second spelling of a fact the call expression has), an INHERITED field (`inheritedWidget` — declared in the base type, which this file does not state), and a chain through an untyped receiver is covered by the inherited case. A consumer that trusts owner must get NULL, not a guess, exactly where the file is silent. DEPTH UPDATE 2026-10-19: the implicit-this READ (this.fieldWidget) is no longer refused — the depth campaign's `this` evidence class publishes the enclosing type as the declaring type, so its old forbid became a positive expectation at the same line. The class-qualified static call (`Helper.help()`) and the inherited field (`inheritedWidget`) refusals are UNCHANGED and still forbidded.
